title: Critical Nucleation in Colossal Magnetoresistance
abstract: Critical exponents have been obtained for a 3D spin particle system. Clusters are formed and system reaches a critical behavior when fragment size distribution follows a power law, as predicted by Fisher Liquid Droplet Model. Also, spontaneous magnetization critical temperature is in agreement with other theoretical studies. System evolution is reproduced via a genetic algorithm that performs minimal genetic fluctuations until a stationary state is attained. Critical exponents are in the range of those belonging to Heavy Ion collisions previously reported, and therefore belong to the same universality class.
